quote: Nota che notar Jacobo de Policastro, castellano de Viglevano, a dì 26 del suprascripto, è passato de la presente vita.
source: Natale ed. I diari di Cicco Simonetta (IA BiblioFBK-FISA-A-01); entry under 26 Aug 1478
note: Confirms still castellan Vigevano at death. Wear order 1460-12-12 → +17y 8m survival in same near-work office. Thin bookends only — not yet dense dated letter series; keep hard=False unless more missives found.
